LESSON: CONVERSATION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 1.5: Conversation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Conversation
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: where, when and why),in during a b) ask and answer relevant questions in class, groups and pairs conversation?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. listen to informational texts and pick ask questions using cue words(such as listen to others out the key details who what, where, when and why),in during a
2. demonstrate respect for others when  Learners engage in role play and participating in a conversation dramatization (theme my family and my 153
3. appreciate the use of socially community.) acceptable language and mannerisms 

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Conversation

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Conversation

Teach
• Focus skill: listen to informational texts and pick ask questions using cue words(such as listen to others out the key details who what, where, when and why),in during a.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Conversation.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Conversation
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. where, when and why),in during a b) ask and answer relevant questions in class, groups and pairs conversation?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
